snippet.title: Atmosfar Gameplay Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Apoq Lab's Atmosfar is an open-world survival game where you road trip around a series of atmospheric floating islands. This solo and co-operative adventure is dropping into early access later this year on PC.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1798230/ATMOSFAR/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
